examples.line1: This week, Israel's prime minister warned that an Iranian bomb would mean a second Holocaust.
examples.line2: But sixty-six years ago, in the Negev desert, Israel was secretly building its own.
examples.now: Estimates now run past one hundred warheads. Israel has never admitted a single one.
examples.question: Who decides which country may have the bomb?

facts: Dimona reactor built in secret from 1958-60; Ben-Gurion said it was peaceful; Kennedy pressed for inspections; first bomb by early 1967; Vanunu leaked photos in 1986.

lines.say: Its prime minister told parliament the reactor was designed exclusively for peaceful purposes.
President Kennedy pressed him to let American inspectors in.
By early 1967, Israel had finished its first bomb.
In 1986, a technician named Mordechai Vanunu leaked photos from inside Dimona to a London newspaper.
